name: Marmasparshee Priyadarshini

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Marmasparshee Priyadarshini’s contribution to Kabita Live, ‘The Arrival of Spring’, imagines the season as a correspondence between a woman and the sky. A folded letter becomes a boat of wishes; flowers supply colour and scent to its language. The poem’s movement depends on these small transformations, carrying an intimate gesture into the wider garden.

Punctuation becomes part of that living world: a bird carries a full stop, the breeze turns pages, and the sky sends down pauses with pollen. By the close, butterflies can read a language newly grown among the flowers. Writing and renewal become inseparable in this playful account of how a season answers human longing.
